root_cause.summary: The currency service container has stopped (exited), causing DNS lookup failures for the frontend service. This results in a high error rate observed on the frontend. Users experience failed API requests when the frontend tries to call currency.

evidence.why_it_matters: Service health shows currency is NOT_REPORTING: DOWN with high deviation_score.
Traces from frontend show deepest failing span DNS lookup ENOTFOUND currency (dns_failure).

proposed_action.reason: Currency service container is stopped, causing DNS lookup failures in frontend and elevated error rate.
